title: Live Regions & Dynamic Content Updates 🔄
description: Use aria-live to politely or assertively announce content changes to screen reader users.

slides.title: The Problem: Silent Updates 🤫
slides.content:
When content changes dynamically (new chat message, form validation error, search results updating), sighted users see it – but screen readers may not announce it.

**ARIA live regions** make these updates audible.

quizData.question: What happens by default when you insert text into a page via JavaScript?

options.text: Screen readers may not announce it unless it's a live region

slides.title: The `aria-live` Attribute 🔊
slides.content:
Add `aria-live` to a container; its changes will be announced.

* **`off`** (default) – no announcement.
* **`polite`** – announces when the user is idle (waits for current speech to finish).
* **`assertive`** – interrupts current speech (use sparingly).

Use `aria-atomic` to control whether the entire region or just the changed part is read.

`aria-relevant` defines what changes trigger announcement: `additions`, `removals`, `text`.

slides.title: Polite Live Region Example

quizData.question: Which `aria-live` value should you use for a critical error message that needs immediate attention?
quizData.explanation: `assertive` interrupts and announces immediately, suitable for urgent alerts.

slides.title: Live Region Roles 🏥
slides.content:
Certain roles have implicit live region properties:

* `role="alert"` – assertive live region for important messages.
* `role="status"` – polite live region for status updates.
* `role="log"` – polite, and additions are read (like a chat log).
* `role="marquee"` – (avoid it).

Use these instead of bare `<div aria-live>` when the semantics match.

slides.title: Alert Role for Errors
slides.codeSnippet: Your session will expire in 5 minutes.

quizData.question: Which role automatically acts as a polite live region?

slides.title: Live Region Pitfalls ⚠️
slides.content:
* **Don't overuse assertive** – interrupts are jarring.
* **Always insert the live region in the DOM on page load** – dynamically adding a live region may not work.
* **Don't hide live region from screen readers** (no `aria-hidden`).
* **Test with real screen readers** – behaviour varies.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## To re‑announce the same text
Some screen readers ignore repeated identical text. Clear the region first (`innerHTML = ''`), then insert the new text after a brief delay.
